# Abdillamit Mamytov

> Full-Stack engineer from Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. Works at Mancho Devs and mentors frontend students at Mancho School.

## About

Abdillamit Mamytov grew up in Baul village, Leilek district, Batken region, in the far south of Kyrgyzstan. He taught himself with Udemy and YouTube, studied software engineering at Mancho School and since September 2024 works at Mancho Devs as a Full-Stack Software Engineer.

He builds web apps and admin panels for products such as finik.pay (payments), SlonExpress (international logistics), umrahhajj (Hajj and Umrah management) and mancho.school (education). Stack: React, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, Redux, RxJS, Node.js, AWS serverless.
